description: This file implements the Time class and related functions for handling date and time operations, including parsing various date formats, converting between local and UTC times, and computing Julian dates. It references external headers and system APIs for time management.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class representing date and time, providing methods for parsing, formatting, and conversions between time zones and formats.

methods.name: Time::ToLocal
methods.description: Converts the stored time to local time.

methods.name: Time::ToUTC
methods.description: Converts the stored time to UTC.

methods.name: Time::Ticks
methods.description: Returns the time in microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: Time::Format
methods.description: Formats the time according to a specified formatter string.

methods.name: Time::ToRFC1123
methods.description: Returns the time formatted as an RFC 1123 string.

methods.name: Time::ToISO8601
methods.description: Returns the time formatted as an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: Time::ToTimeOnly
methods.description: Returns the time component as a string.

methods.name: Time::DayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the day of the week.

methods.name: Time::DayOfYear
methods.description: Returns the day of the year.

methods.name: Time::Add
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the current time.

methods.name: Time::Sub
methods.description: Subtracts milliseconds from the current time.
